title: Auto-digest's source_query field plumbing
wanted_capability: When `task-completed` signal triggers auto-digest, the trigger payload should include the originating `source_query` so digest can be sourced-specific.
notes: Codex's M3 fix relaxed the rule (reject only when ALL three sources absent), but the trigger plumbing for `source_query` is still missing. When task-completed signal lands, populate it.
